actions.name: R2-1: Syntax - Nullish Coalescing
actions.description: Tests whether the ?? operator parses. Writes syn-nullish.json on success.

actions.name: R2-2: Syntax - Template/Destructure/Spread/Defaults
actions.description: Tests four common modern syntax features together. Writes syn-common.json on success.

actions.name: R2-3: Syntax - Static Built-in Access
actions.description: Tests which Object/Array static helpers the sandbox allows. Writes syn-static.json on success.

actions.name: R2-4: Syntax - try/catch Inside A Function
actions.description: Tests whether a catch binding works inside a nested function. Writes syn-nestedcatch.json on success.

actions.name: R2-5: Object Shapes
actions.description: Dumps the shape of _vars, tracks, playlists and custom tags. Read-only. Select the sandbox tracks first.

actions.name: R2-6: Permission Denial
actions.description: Touches capabilities this action was NOT granted and records how each fails. Read-only.

actions.name: R2-7: Settings Coercion
actions.description: Reports the runtime type of each declared setting. Read-only.
